{{Quote|Celanon, Nar Shaddaa, Ixtlar—plenty of worlds got a multicolored skyline—but even they pale before the shine of a Corporate Sector world.|Han Solo|<ref name="HSSB">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
'''Ixtlar''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Ixtlar system/Legends|Ixtlar system]] on of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], situated on the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]]<ref name="TEA" /> in the [[Ixtlar sector/Legends|Ixtlar sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was covered in [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] [[Holoboard/Legends|advertisement signs]].<ref name ="HSSB" /> Almost any merchandise could be found on Ixtlar. 

Ixtlar was one of the Core planets that benefited during the expansion and the colonization wave towards [[the Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="TEA" />

In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], it was the site of the [[Battle of Ixtlar (Clone Wars)|Battle of Ixtlar]], one of several battles of the [[Foerost campaign]]  between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Victory Fleet]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist's]] [[Bulwark Fleet]]. The battle was inconclusive as the Bulwark Fleet remained a threat, forcing the Victory Fleet to pursue it further.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

The [[Thief/Legends|thief]] [[Cecil Noone]] conned wealthy tourists on Ixtlar with rigged games of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]].<ref name="Herdship">{{JournalCite|15|The Great Herdship Heist}}</ref>

Ixtlar was conquered by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]],<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]</ref> but the Yuuzhan Vong were driven out of the Core after the fall of Yuuzhan'tar.

At an unknown time, a station at Ixtlar mysteriously [[Ixtlar incident|exploded]] &mdash; it was the meeting place of a [[Human/Legends|Human]]-only faction of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] and is rumored to have been sabotaged by a rival faction. This event pushed the Guild to accept recruits of all species, even allowing [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to join.<ref name="BHC" />
